name: Toaster
description: Check whether it can be repaired before recycling.

name: Desk Lamp
description: Try a repair workshop or ask an e-waste service about collection.

name: Electric Kettle
description: Check local repair and e-waste options for unwanted electrical items.

description: Mend damaged clothing or pass on clean, wearable items.

description: Reuse bottles and jars where practical. Check your council's recycling guidance.
